name: Password Guide
description: Password input paired with a hand-drawn notebook and lock illustration. A checklist of rules gets struck through as each is met, and a check badge pops in when all pass.
contents: Illustrated lock and notebook SVG with a rule checklist
Password input with show/hide text button
behavior: Rules for length, lowercase, uppercase and number are checked live as the user types
Each satisfied rule is struck through with an animated line
A check badge scales in when all rules are met
Show/hide button toggles the input between password and text
editableByProps: Placeholder, rule labels, show/hide labels and minimum length
Background, input, notebook, lock, strike and badge colors, input radius

needsCodeEdit.where: RULE_TESTS constant and the rules array

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the notebook and lock illustration
needsCodeEdit.where: svg elements inside the relative w-[250px] block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Special Elite font through a Google Fonts link
Illustration size is fixed at 250px wide
